Why NEEDED is not a scheduler state
Rerun is per submission, so exactly one
container works on a submission at a time.
There is nothing to race against, so no claim
step and no IN_PROGRESS state are required.
Retry falls out of the design: a task that
fails stays NEEDED, the submission guard is
not set, and the next nightly trigger picks
the submission up and retries only the tasks
solely to stop a permanently broken target
submissions. After the IMMEDIATE pass, NIGHTLY
tasks are still NEEDED, so the submission
enters the queue with no extra flag, and the
IMMEDIATE tasks are skipped on the rerun
target deserves feedback. It is the token
saving, and the instructor controls it through
whether this submission is finished. The
nightly trigger filters on it, so a fully
graded submission is never rerun. The AI phase
re-checks it, which catches reruns the trigger
did not cause, such as an instructor debugging
